title: Firecrawl to ChatGPT
description: Connect Firecrawl to a supported ChatGPT workspace using the public MCP endpoints without placing API keys in the walkthrough.

steps.title: Open ChatGPT web
steps.body: Use ChatGPT in a browser and switch to the workspace where you want the connector. On a phone, Desktop site may expose settings that the native mobile layout hides.
steps.humanGate: Workspace sign-in and administrator permissions stay under your control.

steps.title: Find Settings
steps.body: Use Find on page to locate Settings or Apps. CTRL highlights visible controls but does not approve workspace-wide permissions for you.

steps.title: Copy the keyless MCP URL
steps.body: Start with Firecrawl's public keyless MCP endpoint so no API secret needs to be entered into CTRL Walkthrough.

steps.title: Find the MCP server field
steps.body: On the app/connector creation page, use Find on page to locate the server URL or MCP URL field. Paste the copied URL there and choose no authentication for the keyless test if that option is available.

steps.title: Scan tools
steps.body: Use Find on page to locate Scan Tools or the equivalent validation control. Review the discovered tools before creating or publishing anything.
steps.humanGate: Creating, publishing or granting workspace-wide access remains your decision.

steps.title: Optional OAuth connection
steps.body: If you intentionally want account-authenticated Firecrawl access, copy the OAuth MCP endpoint and complete the provider's browser authorization yourself.
steps.humanGate: OAuth consent and account authorization require your confirmation.

steps.title: Open Firecrawl MCP documentation
steps.body: Use current provider documentation as the authority if the setup UI or supported authentication modes change.
